stories.title: Ukraine launches over 1,000 drones at Russia in largest-ever attack on Moscow
stories.summary: Ukraine fired more than 1,000 drones at Russia overnight, including what Moscow called its largest attack on the capital, targeting an oil refinery and killing two people. The massed strike marks an escalation of long-range strikes deep into Russian territory.

stories.title: US and China trade teams open New York talks on AI, tariffs and Iran
stories.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and China's Vice Premier He Lifeng are meeting in New York to tee up potential agreements on AI, trade and critical minerals ahead of this week's Trump-Xi summit in Washington. A US-China trade truce expires on November 10.

stories.title: Trump to host Xi in Washington on Sept 24 amid AI, Iran and trade tensions
stories.summary: President Trump will welcome Chinese leader Xi Jinping for his first White House visit in a decade next week, with AI regulation, the Iran war and tariff truce on the agenda. Analysts expect an extension of a diplomatic truce rather than concrete breakthroughs.

stories.title: Trump says US will form an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI tsar
stories.summary: President Trump said his administration will form an 'AI Force' and appoint an AI tsar, pledging not to hinder the growth of the technology. The announcement comes amid intensifying warnings about frontier AI risks.

stories.title: The 'Chief of Staff' pattern for orchestrating Claude Code agents gains traction on Hacker News
stories.summary: A widely-shared write-up on Hacker News argues long-horizon AI coding fails less from agent skill than from ephemeral context, proposing one long-lived coordinator session to assign work and verify claims while short-lived sessions execute. It's resonating as teams scale agent orchestration.

stories.title: Browns face Buccaneers in Week 2 as both 0-1 teams look to avoid a slow start
stories.summary: The Cleveland Browns visit the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday as both teams try to even their record at 1-1 after rough Week 1 losses. USA TODAY's experts have locked in their picks and predictions against the spread for the matchup.

stories.title: Buckeyes postgame reaction: Ohio State blows out Kent State 59-3
stories.summary: The sixth-ranked Buckeyes rolled to a 59-3 win over Kent State, with Jeremiah Smith becoming Ohio State's career receiving yardage leader. Analysts unpacked what the dominant bounce-back after last week's Texas loss means going forward.

stories.title: Second man charged in shooting involving Columbus police near Gibbard Avenue
stories.summary: Daniel Wagner, 22, was charged with five counts of felonious assault and four counts of felonious assault on a peace officer after an August shooting near a Northeast Columbus church where officers were investigating a drive-by and shots were fired at police. He was arraigned on a $5 million bond.
